chrome_detail_observations.method: Actual Chrome navigation to 137 production detail URLs. Each named heading and visible inactive banner was checked after the profile-update message cleared. Reviewed the presence and enabled state of Draft email and presence of Apply now. No email or application was opened or sent. Six IDs required the visible Retry button before the intended page showed. Three additional IDs did not verify the expected heading during the first pass and subsequently verified by navigating to their normal URLs. The first-pass errors are preserved, not counted as clean first loads.

acceptance_boundaries.production_scope: All 101 NCSU fourth-release retirement corrections and the 1 Wisconsin retirement resolve to the intended original public pages, show the inactive notice, and have no Draft email or Apply now. All 35 controls still expose the enabled Draft email button. Five of these controls have subsequently been confirmed retired; their remaining contact buttons are tracked in #1373. A sixth separate outside-college record (Braden) is tracked in #1368.
